import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

DATASET_PATH = 'chunks_csv/bivariate/bivariate_2021_gas_waste.csv'

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv(DATASET_PATH)
adj = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)

print('Main data shape:', df.shape)
print('Adjacency shape:', adj.shape)

# Get unique boroughs from main data
boroughs = df['borough'].unique()
n = len(boroughs)
print('Number of boroughs:', n)

# Check if all boroughs in adjacency are in main data
adj_boroughs = set(adj['borough'].unique()) | set(adj['neighbor'].unique())
missing_in_main = adj_boroughs - set(boroughs)
missing_in_adj = set(boroughs) - adj_boroughs
print('Boroughs in adjacency but not main:', missing_in_main)
print('Boroughs in main but not adjacency:', missing_in_adj)

# Create a mapping from borough name to index
borough_to_idx = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(boroughs)}

# Build symmetric adjacency matrix
W = np.zeros((n, n))
for _, row in adj.iterrows():
    b = row['borough']
    neigh = row['neighbor']
    if b in borough_to_idx and neigh in borough_to_idx:
        i = borough_to_idx[b]
        j = borough_to_idx[neigh]
        W[i, j] = 1
        W[j, i] = 1  # ensure symmetry

# Check diagonal
np.fill_diagonal(W, 0)

# Row-standardize
row_sums = W.sum(axis=1)
print('Row sums (neighbors per borough):', row_sums)
print('Min neighbors:', row_sums.min(), 'Max neighbors:', row_sums.max())

# Handle any isolated boroughs (shouldn't happen, but just in case)
W_row = np.zeros_like(W)
for i in range(n):
    if row_sums[i] > 0:
        W_row[i, :] = W[i, :] / row_sums[i]
    else:
        W_row[i, i] = 1  # self-weight if isolated

# Merge data to ensure correct order
df_ordered = pd.DataFrame({'borough': boroughs}).merge(df, on='borough', how='left')
print('Ordered data shape:', df_ordered.shape)
print(df_ordered.head())

# Extract values
gas = df_ordered['Gas_value'].values
waste = df_ordered['Waste_value'].values

# Standardize to z-scores (using sample std)
z_gas = (gas - np.mean(gas)) / np.std(gas, ddof=1)
z_waste = (waste - np.mean(waste)) / np.std(waste, ddof=1)

print('z_gas mean:', np.mean(z_gas), 'std:', np.std(z_gas, ddof=1))
print('z_waste mean:', np.mean(z_waste), 'std:', np.std(z_waste, ddof=1))

# Compute spatial lag of Waste
lag_waste = W_row @ z_waste
print('lag_waste mean:', np.mean(lag_waste), 'std:', np.std(lag_waste, ddof=1))

# Compute observed test statistic: Pearson correlation between z_gas and lag_waste
observed_stat = np.corrcoef(z_gas, lag_waste)[0, 1]
print('Observed correlation (Lee\'s L / Bivariate Moran\'s I):', observed_stat)

# Permutation test: shuffle Gas values across boroughs, recompute correlation
# Keep spatial lag of Waste fixed, shuffle Gas
np.random.seed(42)
n_perm = 1000
perm_stats = np.zeros(n_perm)

for i in range(n_perm):
    perm_gas = np.random.permutation(z_gas)
    perm_stat = np.corrcoef(perm_gas, lag_waste)[0, 1]
    perm_stats[i] = perm_stat

# Compute p-value (two-tailed)
# Since we're testing for positive or negative association
p_value = np.mean(np.abs(perm_stats) >= np.abs(observed_stat))
print('Permutation p-value (two-tailed):', p_value)

# Also check one-tailed p-values
p_positive = np.mean(perm_stats >= observed_stat)
p_negative = np.mean(perm_stats <= observed_stat)
print('One-tailed p (positive):', p_positive)
print('One-tailed p (negative):', p_negative)

# Summary statistics of null distribution
print('Null distribution mean:', np.mean(perm_stats))
print('Null distribution std:', np.std(perm_stats))
print('Null distribution min:', np.min(perm_stats))
print('Null distribution max:', np.max(perm_stats))

    if b in borough_to_idx and neigh in borough_to_idx:

        j = borough_to_idx[neigh]
        W[i, j] = 1

# Make symmetric, remove diagonal
W = np.maximum(W, W.T)
np.fill_diagonal(W, 0)

row_sums = W.sum(axis=1)
W_row = np.zeros_like(W, dtype=float)
for i in range(n):
    if row_sums[i] > 0:
        W_row[i, :] = W[i, :] / row_sums[i]

# Get values

waste = df_complete['Waste_value'].values

# Standardize using population std (mean 0, sum of squares = n)
z_gas = (gas - np.mean(gas)) / np.std(gas, ddof=0)
z_waste = (waste - np.mean(waste)) / np.std(waste, ddof=0)

# Compute spatial lag of Waste
lag_waste = W_row @ z_waste

# Compute Lee's L statistic exactly

denominator = np.sqrt((z_gas @ z_gas) * (z_waste @ z_waste))

corr_stat = np.corrcoef(z_gas, lag_waste)[0, 1]
print('Correlation statistic:', corr_stat)

# Permutation test for Lee's L with more permutations

    den_perm = np.sqrt((perm_gas @ perm_gas) * (z_waste @ z_waste))
    perm_L[i] = num_perm / den_perm

p_value_two_tailed = np.mean(np.abs(perm_L) >= np.abs(lee_L))
p_value_negative = np.mean(perm_L <= lee_L)

print('Permutation test (5000 permutations):')
print('Observed Lee\'s L:', lee_L)
print('Two-tailed p-value:', p_value_two_tailed)
print('One-tailed p (negative):', p_value_negative)
print('Null mean:', np.mean(perm_L), 'std:', np.std(perm_L))

df_complete = df.dropna(subset=['Waste_value']).copy()

# Get boroughs for analysis
boroughs = df_complete['borough'].values
n = len(boroughs)

# Create mapping
borough_to_idx = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(boroughs)}

# Build adjacency matrix (only for complete boroughs)
W = np.zeros((n, n), dtype=int)
for _, row in adj.iterrows():
    b = row['borough']
    neigh = row['neighbor']
    if b in borough_to_idx and neigh in borough_to_idx:
        i = borough_to_idx[b]
        j = borough_to_idx[neigh]
        W[i, j] = 1

# Make symmetric and zero out diagonal
W = np.maximum(W, W.T)
np.fill_diagonal(W, 0)

# Row-standardize
row_sums = W.sum(axis=1)
W_row = np.zeros_like(W, dtype=float)
for i in range(n):
    if row_sums[i] > 0:
        W_row[i, :] = W[i, :] / row_sums[i]
    else:
        W_row[i, i] = 1  # self-loop for isolated, though none should exist

# Get values and standardize
gas = df_complete['Gas_value'].values
waste = df_complete['Waste_value'].values

# Use population standardization (ddof=0) for Lee's L consistency
z_gas = (gas - np.mean(gas)) / np.std(gas, ddof=0)
z_waste = (waste - np.mean(waste)) / np.std(waste, ddof=0)

# Lee's L
numerator = z_gas @ (W_row @ z_waste)
denominator = np.sqrt((z_gas @ z_gas) * (z_waste @ z_waste))
lee_L = numerator / denominator

# Permutation test with 10000 permutations
np.random.seed(12345)
n_perm = 10000
perm_L = np.zeros(n_perm)

zz_waste = z_waste.copy()

for i in range(n_perm):
    perm_gas = np.random.permutation(z_gas)
    num_perm = perm_gas @ (W_row @ zz_waste)
    den_perm = np.sqrt((perm_gas @ perm_gas) * (zz_waste @ zz_waste))
    perm_L[i] = num_perm / den_perm

# Two-tailed p-value
p_value = np.mean(np.abs(perm_L) >= np.abs(lee_L))

print('=' * 50)
print('FINAL RESULTS')
print('=' * 50)
print(f\"Observed Lee's L: {lee_L:.6f}\")
print(f\"Two-tailed p-value ({n_perm} perms): {p_value:.6f}\")
